dimensions.note: Explicit credentials are optional only as a pair, marked sensitive, never logged, and omitted to use the standard AWS provider chain.
Every public method logs entry and completion without bucket, prefix, key, credentials, or object content.
All SDK failures receive sanitized operation context; validation and API failures precede output, and failed streams retain only an intentional pending recovery marker.
Fourteen mocked Deno tests cover command contracts, malformed API and configuration input, credential pairing, API sanitization, prefix and size bounds, cleanup, stream races, and persistence.
The extension has no remote mutations and uses stable per-spec instance names; interrupted downloads have deterministic pending metadata.

Only HeadBucket, ListObjectsV2, HeadObject, and GetObject are available; list requests are single-page and bounded by MaxKeys, truncation is explicit, range verification is one byte, and consumed response fields are validated.
S3 clients are destroyed in finally and the range-probe reader is cancelled in finally.
README and tests use reserved example domains, placeholder buckets, keys, and credentials; no real infrastructure or object content is included.
All object schemas are strict, bucket/prefix/key/list/byte inputs are bounded, and schema-write conformance and field coverage are 1:1 for every writeResource call.
Every resource and sensitive file spec has explicit lifetime and garbage collection.
Purposefully read-only observation model; it manages no remote resource lifecycle.
Verification, listing, file, and metadata specs use distinct stable names; pending and complete metadata intentionally replace the same schema-conformant instance.
Initial unpublished version; registry dry run reports no prior published version.
